FINAL SUMMARY — Turn 6, Phase 0 (#37), branch issue37-phase0-eval-harness

BUDGET EXHAUSTED BEFORE GATES/COMMIT. The workspace is left with a partial, UNCOMMITTED, NOT-YET-GREEN fix set. Reporting honestly rather than claiming completion.

## State read (verified from git + tmp/)
- Branch has 11 commits, HEAD = 01a88808 "context-evals: match the TS reference adapter to the sibling CLI surface". Working tree was clean at start of turn.
- Rust baseline remains as the driver stated: tmp/issue37-p0-baseline-r5b.table (17/17 expected-red), reports under tmp/issue37-baseline-r5b/, tmp/issue37-ts-r5e/report-*.json shows runner=typescript-reference with provider_requests=0, turns_ok=0, wall_hit=false — consistent with the mis-invocation defect.

## Defect 2 root cause (diagnosed, high confidence)
Where `openai` leaked in: `src/context_eval/runner.rs::ts_args()` put the provider string in **bun's pre-script argument position**:
`bun --provider openai --preload ./scripts/dev-env.ts packages/cli/index.ts ...`
Bun treats bare non-flag tokens before the entry script as *scripts/binaries to execute*. The sibling repo has `openai` (^5.10.1) as a dependency in both `package.json:346` and `packages/cli/package.json:85`, so `node_modules/.bin/openai` resolved and ran instead of the CLI — hence ts.stdout `Unknown subcommand --preload. / Usage: openai <subcommand>` and ts.stderr `error: "openai" exited with code 1`. Not a PATH shim, not a bin-name substitution; it was argument order (provider string used as a bun pre-script arg).

## Edits applied (verified applied via tool response + sed re-read)
1. src/context_eval/tests.rs:267 — E0308 fixed: `!ts.iter().any(|a| a == "--session")`. (Verified.)
2. src/context_eval/runner.rs ts_args — removed the leading `"--provider", "openai"` pair so the child argv now starts `bun --preload ./scripts/dev-env.ts packages/cli/index.ts --prompt ...`. (Verified by sed 168-190.)

## Edits NOT applied (tool failures — be explicit)
- Re-adding `--provider openai` AFTER the entry script (i.e. after `--baseurl <url>`, alongside `--key`/`--model`) failed twice: the `replace` on runner.rs reported "expected exactly one occurrence ... found 0" (whitespace/pattern mismatch I did not get to re-derive), and the matching tests.rs edit was refused when the budget hit 0. So the TS adapter currently runs with **no explicit --provider flag**; if provider selection is required beyond `scripts/dev-env.ts` + env, the child may fail differently (e.g. interactive provider prompt or default provider) — unverified.
- Consequence: `src/context_eval/tests.rs` still asserts the OLD argv (leading `"--provider", "openai"`), so `cargo test --lib context_eval` will now fail on that `assert_eq!` even though it should compile.

## Gates — NOT RUN this turn
`cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --offline --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --offline --locked --lib context_eval`: none executed. No TS runner verification run, so `./target/debug/llxprt-context-eval --runner ts --scenarios wall-large-tool-final --out tmp/issue37-ts-r6` was never attempted (attempt 0 of 2 used). No commits, no push, no branch switching.

## Next session (exact, in order)
1. In runner.rs `ts_args`, insert `"--provider".into(), "openai".into(),` immediately after the `--baseurl`/`base_url.to_string()` pair (post-entry-script position, before `--key`); mirror it in tests.rs expected vec after `"--baseurl", "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1"`. Do NOT put any bare token before `packages/cli/index.ts` other than `--preload ./scripts/dev-env.ts`.
2. Run the three gates; then the TS runner command above (timeout via tool `timeout_seconds`; artifacts only under tmp/issue37-*). Expect provider_requests > 0, turns completing, wall_hit=true / reason context-limit — calibration only, never an oracle. Max 2 attempts, then capture and report honestly.
3. Commit small, referencing #37. Baseline Rust results and report schema are already good and must not be regressed.
